name.full: SharePoint Governance Agent — Executive Governance Dashboard

description.short: Governance score, priority actions, and explainable tenant risk findings.
description.full: An executive governance advisor for Microsoft 365 Copilot. Surfaces a 0-100 governance score with a trend indicator, an AI-generated executive summary, prioritized remediation actions, a tenant-wide insights panel, and an estimated risk reduction — with every finding explained in business terms (risk, impact, why it matters, recommended action). Runs entirely on demo (mock) data.
